resources.string:
"An independent app offering DNS ad blocking and experimental HTTPS connection bypass. Not affiliated with AdGuard or Unicorn.

• Ad and tracking domains are checked on your device.
• Allowed DNS queries are sent over HTTPS to your selected Cloudflare or Google provider. If it is unavailable, your network's DNS may be used temporarily depending on your settings.
• DNS-only mode handles only DNS requests.
• With connection bypass enabled, TCP and UDP connections pass through a relay on your device. No overseas server or foreign IP is provided. Your browser still performs HTTPS certificate verification and encryption.
• Blocklist and app update checks connect to GitHub.
• No analytics SDK, account, or remote log collection.

Blocklist: AdAway default blocklist
Kicelo, Dominik Schuermann and contributors · CC BY 3.0
https://github.com/AdAway/adaway.github.io
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Connection relay engine: hev-socks5-tunnel 2.19.3 · MIT
https://github.com/heiher/hev-socks5-tunnel"

"Split connections only for the bypass sites below.\nThis does not provide a foreign IP, and results depend on your network. Turn protection off before changing modes."
"Applies only to listed domains and their subdomains.\nChanges affect new connections. Connections to other sites and messaging apps are not split."
"Connection bypass requires Android 10 or later. DNS ad blocking is available on this device."

"If ads remain, check your browser's secure DNS and Android's “Private DNS” settings. You may need to reopen apps to clear cached ads.

If protection stops when the screen is off, allow NOK to run in the background in battery settings.

Do not enable Android's “Block connections without VPN” option. In DNS-only mode, it may also block normal internet traffic."
